premises.text: Robot innovation is now constrained by expensive complex hardware (actuators/joints), not brains, sensors, or software
premises.evidence_span: robots are no longer constrained by these parts. They're instead constrained by the hardware

premises.text: ModBot modular servo, joint, and link building blocks are versatile, reconfigurable parts for building many robot forms affordably
premises.evidence_span: ModBot identifies the common building blocks found in all robots. The servo, the joint, and the link

premises.text: Phone app enables on-the-fly hardware programming, keyframe recording, and wireless sequence repeat for rapid prototyping
premises.evidence_span: You can use our phone app to do hardware programming on the fly, record key frames and repeat sequences wirelessly

premises.text: Cloud virtual robot builder lets users assemble, program, simulate in a physics engine, share, and order hardware
premises.evidence_span: You can assemble and program your robot on the fly, inside of the browser, and test and simulate in a real physics engine

premises.text: Tightly integrated joint unit combines encoder, motor, transmission, and bearings at roughly one-tenth industrial cost with compactness
premises.evidence_span: we've managed to reduce the cost of an industrial equivalent by about one-tenth

value.text: Quality affordable robot parts that get robots out of labs into everyday inventors' hands and accelerate innovation
value.evidence_span: get robots out of expensive research labs and into the hands of everyday inventors

causal_links.evidence_span: good quality and affordable robot parts
making ModBot easy to use for rapid prototyping

notes: Cost/compactness treated as quantitative/performance package of the integrated joint (v1.5.1 §4.1.8), not separate premises. Example builds (arm, dolly, prosthetic) treated as applications of one modular kit. Crowdfunding launch excluded as traction.
